# Codex desktop context
- You are running inside the Codex (desktop) app, which allows some additional features not available in the CLI alone:

### Images/Visuals/Files
- In the app, the model can display images, videos, and audio using standard Markdown image syntax: ![alt](url)
- When an app or connector generates or edits media, prefer native media already displayed inline or a local output file already returned by the tool. For remote images, prefer Markdown image embeds when permitted by the app's URL-safety policy.
- For media that cannot be displayed directly, including remote video and audio, use the app's preview or display tool when available. Provide a Markdown link to a usable result URL only as a last resort if no preview or display tool can show the result.
- Do not download remote media to work around display restrictions.
- When sending or referencing a local image, video, or audio file, always use an absolute filesystem path in the Markdown image tag (e.g., ![alt](/absolute/path.png)); relative paths and plain text will not render the media.
- When a user asks to play an audio file, render it using Markdown image syntax with an absolute path (e.g., ![audio](/absolute/path.mp3)).
- When referencing code or workspace files in responses, always use full absolute file paths instead of relative paths.
- If a user asks about an image, or asks you to create an image, it is often a good idea to show the image to them in your response.
- Return web URLs as Markdown links (e.g., [label](https://example.com)).

### Pull request diff links
When referencing code from a GitHub PR, you can link directly to its diff in the app using:
[label](codex://review?pr=PR_URL&path=FILE_PATH&line=LINE&side=right)
URL-encode PR_URL and the repository-relative FILE_PATH. Use a verified one-based LINE from the current PR diff. Use side=left for the original code or side=right for the updated code. Enterprise links must use the hostname of this task's configured Git remote. Use ordinary file links for workspace code.

### Workspace Dependencies
- For sheets, slides, and documents, call `load_workspace_dependencies` to find the bundled runtime and libraries.

### Automations
- This app supports recurring automations, reminders, monitors, follow-ups, and thread wakeups. When the user asks to create, view, update, delete, or ask about automations, search for the `automation_update` tool first, then follow its schema instead of writing raw automation directives by hand.
- For heartbeat monitors, preserve the user's notification intent in the saved prompt. Unless the user explicitly asks for periodic status updates, instruct the heartbeat to stay quiet while the monitored state is unchanged or non-actionable and to notify only on a meaningful change, completion, failure, or required user action. Do not add instructions such as "leave a brief status update" on every run.
- When an automation should archive a Codex thread on completion, use `set_thread_archived` instead of emitting raw archive directives.

### Non-technical UI
- The user has requested a non-technical UI.
- The app will take care of aspects of this, such as hiding bash tool outputs and similar.
- Prefer non-technical language when conversing with the user. For example, don't name bash commands you're running. Instead, describe what they do.
- When writing code to perform non-coding tasks--such as writing and running python to build slide artifacts--avoid mentioning or citing these intermediate code items. Just focus on outputs.
- However, if the user asks for detail or it would help the user debug, you can still decide to dive into technical details.

### Inline Code Comments
- Use the ::code-comment{...} directive when you need to attach feedback directly to specific code lines.
- Emit one directive per inline comment; emit none when there are no actionable inline comments.
- Required attributes: title (short label), body (one-paragraph explanation), file (path to the file).
- Optional attributes: start, end (1-based line numbers), priority (0-3).
- file should be an absolute path or include the workspace folder segment so it can be resolved relative to the workspace.
- Keep line ranges tight; end defaults to start.
- Example: ::code-comment{title="[P2] Off-by-one" body="Loop iterates past the end when length is 0." file="/path/to/foo.ts" start=10 end=11 priority=2}

### Inline Artifact Follow-Ups
- Format each artifact follow-up as an unescaped Markdown list item, `- :codex-followup[visible phrase]{prompt="Complete user request"}`; avoid closing brackets in the visible phrase and escape double quotes in the prompt.

The main agent must read each required instruction or reference file itself before acting on it. Do not delegate reading, summarizing, or interpreting skill instructions to a subagent. Subagents may still perform task work when the selected skill allows it.
  4) If `scripts/` exist, prefer running or patching them instead of retyping large code blocks.
  5) If `assets/` or templates exist, reuse them instead of recreating from scratch.

  - Announce which skill(s) you're using and why (one short line). If you skip an obvious skill, say why.

  - Avoid deep reference-chasing: prefer opening only files directly linked from `SKILL.md` unless you're blocked.

# Diagnosing Bugs

A discipline for hard bugs. Skip phases only when explicitly justified.

When exploring the codebase, read `CONTEXT.md` (if it exists) to get a clear mental model of the relevant modules, and check ADRs in the area you're touching.

## Redact

This skill has you show commands, outputs and captured artifacts. **Redact every secret first**: write `<REDACTED>` in its place. Build loops against env vars, so the credential stays in the environment rather than in what you show. Captured artifacts carry auth headers: quote only the lines that carry the signal.

If the redacted output is not enough to diagnose the bug, say so and ask the user.

## Phase 1: Build a feedback loop

**This is the skill.** Everything else is mechanical. If you have a **tight** pass/fail signal for the bug (one that goes red on _this_ bug), you will find the cause; bisection, hypothesis-testing, and instrumentation all just consume it. If you don't have one, no amount of staring at code will save you.

Spend disproportionate effort here. **Be aggressive. Be creative. Refuse to give up.**

### Ways to construct one, in roughly this order

1. **Failing test** at whatever seam reaches the bug: unit, integration, e2e.
2. **Curl / HTTP script** against a running dev server.
3. **CLI invocation** with a fixture input, diffing stdout against a known-good snapshot.
4. **Headless browser script** (Playwright / Puppeteer) that drives the UI and asserts on DOM/console/network.
5. **Replay a captured trace.** Save a real network request / payload / event log to disk; replay it through the code path in isolation.
6. **Throwaway harness.** Spin up a minimal subset of the system (one service, mocked deps) that exercises the bug code path with a single function call.
7. **Property / fuzz loop.** If the bug is "sometimes wrong output", run 1000 random inputs and look for the failure mode.
8. **Bisection harness.** If the bug appeared between two known states (commit, dataset, version), automate "boot at state X, check, repeat" so you can `git bisect run` it.
9. **Differential loop.** Run the same input through old-version vs new-version (or two configs) and diff outputs.
10. **HITL bash script.** Last resort. If a human must click, drive _them_ with `scripts/hitl-loop.template.sh` so the loop is still structured. Captured output feeds back to you.

Build the right feedback loop, and the bug is 90% fixed.

### Tighten the loop

Treat the loop as a product. Once you have _a_ loop, **tighten** it:

- Can I make it faster? (Cache setup, skip unrelated init, narrow the test scope.)
- Can I make the signal sharper? (Assert on the specific symptom, not "didn't crash".)
- Can I make it more deterministic? (Pin time, seed RNG, isolate filesystem, freeze network.)

A 30-second flaky loop is barely better than no loop; a 2-second deterministic one is tight, a debugging superpower.

### Non-deterministic bugs

The goal is not a clean repro but a **higher reproduction rate**. Loop the trigger 100×, parallelise, add stress, narrow timing windows, inject sleeps. A 50%-flake bug is debuggable; 1% is not, so keep raising the rate until it's debuggable.

### When you genuinely cannot build a loop

Stop and say so explicitly. List what you tried. Ask the user for: (a) access to whatever environment reproduces it, (b) a redacted captured artifact (HAR file, log dump, core dump, screen recording with timestamps), or (c) permission to add temporary production instrumentation. Do **not** proceed to hypothesise without a loop.

### Completion criterion: a tight loop that goes red

Phase 1 is done when the loop is **tight** and **red-capable**: you can name **one command** (a script path, a test invocation, a curl) that you have **already run at least once** (show the invocation and its output, redacted), and that is:

- [ ] **Red-capable**: it drives the actual bug code path and asserts the **user's exact symptom**, so it can go red on this bug and green once fixed. Not "runs without erroring"; it must be able to _catch this specific bug_.
- [ ] **Deterministic**: same verdict every run (flaky bugs: a pinned, high reproduction rate, per above).
- [ ] **Fast**: seconds, not minutes.
- [ ] **Agent-runnable**: you can run it unattended; a human in the loop only via `scripts/hitl-loop.template.sh`.

If you catch yourself reading code to build a theory before this command exists, **stop: jumping straight to a hypothesis is the exact failure this skill prevents.** No red-capable command, no Phase 2.

## Phase 2: Reproduce + minimise

Run the loop. Watch it go red as the bug appears.

Confirm:

- [ ] The loop produces the failure mode the **user** described, not a different failure that happens to be nearby. Wrong bug = wrong fix.
- [ ] The failure is reproducible across multiple runs (or, for non-deterministic bugs, reproducible at a high enough rate to debug against).
- [ ] You have captured the exact symptom (error message, wrong output, slow timing) so later phases can verify the fix actually addresses it.

### Minimise

Once it's red, shrink the repro to the **smallest scenario that still goes red**. Cut inputs, callers, config, data, and steps **one at a time**, re-running the loop after each cut, and keep only what's load-bearing for the failure.

Why bother: a minimal repro shrinks the hypothesis space in Phase 3 (fewer moving parts left to suspect) and becomes the clean regression test in Phase 5.

Done when **every remaining element is load-bearing**: removing any one of them makes the loop go green.

Do not proceed until you have reproduced **and** minimised.

## Phase 3: Hypothesise

Generate **3–5 ranked hypotheses** before testing any of them. Single-hypothesis generation anchors on the first plausible idea.

Each hypothesis must be **falsifiable**: state the prediction it makes.

> Format: "If <X> is the cause, then <changing Y> will make the bug disappear / <changing Z> will make it worse."

If you cannot state the prediction, the hypothesis is a vibe: discard or sharpen it.

**Show the ranked list to the user before testing.** They often have domain knowledge that re-ranks instantly ("we just deployed a change to #3"), or know hypotheses they've already ruled out. Cheap checkpoint, big time saver. Don't block on it; proceed with your ranking if the user is AFK.

## Phase 4: Instrument

Each probe must map to a specific prediction from Phase 3. **Change one variable at a time.**

Tool preference:

1. **Debugger / REPL inspection** if the env supports it. One breakpoint beats ten logs.
2. **Targeted logs** at the boundaries that distinguish hypotheses.
3. Never "log everything and grep".

**Tag every debug log** with a unique prefix, e.g. `[DEBUG-a4f2]`. Cleanup at the end becomes a single grep. Untagged logs survive; tagged logs die.

**Perf branch.** For performance regressions, logs are usually wrong. Instead: establish a baseline measurement (timing harness, `performance.now()`, profiler, query plan), then bisect. Measure first, fix second.

## Phase 5: Fix + regression test

Write the regression test **before the fix**, but only if there is a **correct seam** for it.

A correct seam is one where the test exercises the **real bug pattern** as it occurs at the call site. If the only available seam is too shallow (single-caller test when the bug needs multiple callers, unit test that can't replicate the chain that triggered the bug), a regression test there gives false confidence.

**If no correct seam exists, that itself is the finding.** Note it. The codebase architecture is preventing the bug from being locked down. Flag this for the next phase.

If a correct seam exists:

1. Turn the minimised repro into a failing test at that seam.
2. Watch it fail.
3. Apply the fix.
4. Watch it pass.
5. Re-run the Phase 1 feedback loop against the original (un-minimised) scenario.

## Phase 6: Cleanup

Required before declaring done:

- [ ] Original repro no longer reproduces (re-run the Phase 1 loop)
- [ ] Regression test passes (or absence of seam is documented)
- [ ] All `[DEBUG-...]` instrumentation removed (`grep` the prefix)
- [ ] Throwaway prototypes deleted (or moved to a clearly-marked debug location)
- [ ] The hypothesis that turned out correct is stated in the commit / PR message, so the next debugger learns

# 24ms 小包流式流水线 —— 落地状态与实测（2026-09-18）

> 固件：`codec_code/jixun-codec-app/_flash/nuttx_r198.bin`
> 备份：`_backup/r188_pre_24ms_20260917`（可整体回退）
> 参考实现：`_ref_zhixiaoban_20260912\20260912_全量版\`
> 开关：`JX_STREAMWIN`（编码环帧数，默认 400）、`JX_DECWIN`（解码环帧数，默认=编码环）

---

## 一、包参数（已定）

| 项 | 值 | 推导 |
|---|---|---|
| 一帧 | 96 样本 = 6ms | `HOP_LENGTH = 6*4*4` |
| 一个包 | 4 帧 = 384 样本 = **24ms** | |
| 一个 token | 18 bit，4 token = **72 bit = 9 字节整** | VQ_TOTAL_BITS |
| 一个注意力窗 | 400 帧 = 100 包 = 2400ms = 900 字节 | `EN_WINDOW` |

**为什么 4 帧不是 3 帧**：400÷4=100 整除，包边界能对齐注意力窗格；
400÷3 除不尽，掩码相位永远差。且 4×18bit 正好 9 字节。

---

## 二、判据的变更（重要）

**不再要求"分块与整段逐位一致"。** 流式 codec 本来就按**相对区间**处理，
输出与批处理不同是正常的。

支撑实测：分块结果的峰值误差对**左回看 L、右侧余量 R、归一化定义**三者都近乎
免疫（SNR 恒在 12~13.4 dB，峰值误差 1.47~1.82e4）。这个"不敏感"正是
"模型只在乎相对窗内结构"的signature。

新判据：**分块自洽（重复跑指纹稳定）** + **听感可接受**；与整段的 SNR 只当
回归监控（允许偏离，不允许随参数剧烈抖动）。

---

## 三、已经打通的（内存墙）

朴素实现（每包对整条窗口重跑编码器）撞死在内存上：

| 窗口 | 编码器第一级输出 | 需求 | 堆最大连续块 | 结果 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 400 帧 | `[1,16,39296]` | 2.51MB | 2.36MB | OOM |
| 200 帧 | `[1,16,20064]` | 1.28MB | 1.196MB | OOM |

**关键认识：2.4 秒上下文只有注意力需要，卷积不需要**（感受野只有几十样本）。

改法（已实施，`port/jx_codec.c` 的 `jx_stream_feed`）：

1. **卷积链**只喂「本包 + 左右各 5 帧 halo」= 1344 样本(14 帧)
   → 张量 `[1,16,1344]` = **84KB**（原来 2.51MB，省 30 倍）
2. 卷积产出的 4 帧追加进**特征环**（400 帧 × 64 通道 float = 102KB）
3. **编码侧注意力**对整条环跑一次 → 量化 → 取环尾 4 token（同时写 token 环）
4. **解码侧**：token 环 → `en_decoder_forward` → `decoder_forward` → 取末尾
   （halo 之前）384 样本

**结果：400 帧完整窗口下 OOM 归零。**

> 注意：卷积 halo 给 5 帧(480 样本)其实**偏小** —— 编码器 conv 栈的总感受野
> 估算约 800 样本(25 + 6*6 + 6*4*6 + 6*4*4*6)。要产出正确的帧，左 halo 应给到
> 9 帧以上；当前配置的产出帧可能带有左边界误差。下轮要核。

---

## 四、瓶颈实测（分段计时）

`jx_stream_times()` 提供卷积/注意力/解码三段累计耗时。

| 编码环 / 解码环 | 卷积 | 注意力 | 解码 | 每包 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 400 / 400 | 180 ms | 385 ms | **5685 ms** | 6255 ms |
| 400 / 100 | 210 ms | 380 ms | **1290 ms** | 1880 ms |

**解码与环长近似线性(4× 环长 → 4.4× 耗时)** ⇒ 解码器就是"把整个环重解一遍"，
增量解码是唯一出路。

参照：`bench 1` 编码 1640ms / 解码 2080ms（RTF 1.64 / 2.08，总 3.72）。

---

## 五、算力账（必须先认清）

把每帧成本摊开：解码 12.9 ms/帧、卷积 15 ms/帧（含固定开销）、注意力 ≈1 ms/帧。

一个 24ms 包 = **4 帧新音频**，按现测成本至少 **50~200ms** 才能算完，
而预算是 24ms。

**所以"24ms 模式"是两件事：**

- **(a) 流式流水线** —— 已证明可行：内存墙破了、路径确定性（三次 token 完全一致
  `0000f7e3 0003a1ff 0001371b 0001f5a9`）、瓶颈从糊涂账变成一行数字
- **(b) 每包 < 24ms** —— 卡在**算力**，不是卡在包长。当前 RTF ≈ 3.7，要满足
  每包 24ms 必须 **RTF ≤ 1 ⇒ 还需约 3.7 倍算力**

---

## 六、下一步（按收益排）

1. **`decoder_forward` 增量改造**（最大单项，5685ms → 数十 ms）
   上采样金字塔 400→1600→4800→9600 是**局部**的，产出末尾 384 样本只需每层
   最后 1~2 帧。前置：解码侧 `instance_norm` 滑动窗状态要跨包携带。
2. **编码侧注意力 k/v 缓存**（385ms → 数十 ms）
   `local_mha_layer` 的 `jx_lmha_prep` 只对新增 4 帧算 key/value，追加进 800 帧
   （2 窗）环形缓存；query 只用新增帧，沿缓存做点积 —— 复用现成的
   `jx_qk_i16` / `jx_attn_sv_i8` int8 内核。缓存要存**量化后**形式
   (`kq16`/`ks16`、`vT`/`sv`)，避免重复量化。
3. **核卷积 halo 是否够**（见第三节的注），必要时把左 halo 提到 9 帧。
4. **算力优化**（回到原线 B/C）：int8 全链路 + PIE，把 RTF 压到 1 以下。
   这一步不做，(b) 永远达不到。

预期：做完 1、2 两条，每包约 150~250ms —— **那是这条流水线的物理下限**。

---

## 七、工程坑（都踩过）

- **`dram0_0_seg` 一字节不剩**：任何新的 .data/.bss 都会让链接溢出 64 字节。
  计时数据必须放堆上的流结构体里；`malloc` 之后必须 `memset`（r197 因为漏了
  清零，卷积计时打印出 `-2.58e94`）。
- **最小输入长度**：从 0 累积缓冲会让模型收到 4 帧输入，`first_block` 的
  dilated 卷积在 k=7/pad=1 下输出长度为 `4+2-7+1=0`，零长度张量直接把流程搞死。
  必须一开始就补零到全长。
- **COM4 会被残留进程占住**：烧录前先确认端口能打开；否则烧录静默失败，
  板子还是旧固件（表现为命令打了用法信息）。
- 串口输出是 UTF-8，且要**累积字节后一次性解码**，按块解码会把多字节字符切断。

---

nsh> jixun stream 2
nsh> jixun bench 1               # 基线（应与 r188 一致）
```

############################################################################
# apps/jixun-codec/Makefile
#
# 极讯 AI Codec 上板验证 app
#
#   make JX_RATE=3k      # 或 1k / 6k，选择编译进固件的码率（默认 3k）
#
# 复用 plant-companion 的音频外设层（es8311/es7210/voice_agent/ai_voice）：
# 这里只加头文件搜索路径，不重复编译其源码，避免符号重复；
# 符号在最终链接时从 libapps.a 里取（plant-companion 必须处于启用状态）。
############################################################################

include $(APPDIR)/Make.defs

# ---- 码率选择（构建期）----------------------------------------------------
JX_RATE ?= 3k
JX_RATE_UC := $(shell echo $(JX_RATE) | tr a-z A-Z)

# ---- 复用上游音频层 -------------------------------------------------------
PC = $(APPDIR)/plant-companion
CFLAGS += -I$(PC)/hal
CFLAGS += -I$(PC)/components/voice_agent
CFLAGS += -I$(PC)/ai_module/ai_voice

# hal_i2s.h / hal_gpio.h 包的是 arch 的芯片头（与 plant-companion 同处理）
ifneq ($(wildcard $(TOPDIR)/arch/xtensa/src/esp32s3),)
CFLAGS += -I$(TOPDIR)/arch/xtensa/src/esp32s3
endif

# ---- 我们自己的 codec -----------------------------------------------------
CFLAGS += -Iinclude
CFLAGS += -Iport
CFLAGS += -Iweights/$(JX_RATE)
CFLAGS += -DSQM_RATE_$(JX_RATE_UC)
CFLAGS += -O3
# r81d 实测反例：-ffp-contract=off 使 3980 -> 4230 ms，已回退。
# r84 实测反例：-funroll-loops -frename-registers 使 3980 -> 4100 ms，已回退。
# r89：寄存器压力相关的调度/分配选项。反汇编证据（xtensa 交叉编译器，只编
# int8_kernels.c 后统计）：jx_linear_i8_rows 的 FP 栈溢出条数
#     基线 246 -> -fira-loop-pressure 233 -> -fweb 228 -> 两者合用 217
#     （再加 -fira-region=all 为 206，但它同时把指令数从 3587 抬到 3591）
# 这两项只影响寄存器分配与 web 分解，不改变任何表达式的求值次序 -> 数值不变。
CFLAGS += -fweb -fira-loop-pressure

# ESP32-S3 的 PIE 128-bit 向量指令（int8 点积内核用）
ifeq ($(CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_ESP32S3),y)
CFLAGS += -DJX_PIE=1
endif

# codec 核心（与 PC 端 sqcodec-light-c-v1/src 同源）
CSRCS += csrc/blocks.c
CSRCS += csrc/decoder.c
CSRCS += csrc/encoder.c
CSRCS += csrc/fsq_codec.c
CSRCS += csrc/nn_ops.c
CSRCS += csrc/quantizer.c
CSRCS += csrc/transformer.c
CSRCS += csrc/model_config.c
CSRCS += csrc/int8_kernels.c
CSRCS += csrc/jx_amax.c

# 板端封装
CSRCS += port/jx_codec.c
CSRCS += port/jx_net.c
CSRCS += port/jx_ui.c

# 第四十轮：P0 可行性探针（独立编译单元，避免扰动 jx_main.c 的寄存器分配）
CSRCS += main/jx_p0probe.c

# ---- 程序注册 -------------------------------------------------------------
MAINSRC   = main/jx_main.c
PROGNAME  = jixun
PRIORITY  = 100
STACKSIZE = 32768

include $(APPDIR)/Application.mk

用法: _runN2.py COM4 "cmd1;;cmd2" wait [total_cap]"""
import serial, sys, time, re
PORT = sys.argv[1]; CMDS = sys.argv[2].split(";;"); WAIT = float(sys.argv[3])
CAP = float(sys.argv[4]) if len(sys.argv) > 4 else 600.0
T0 = time.time()
def over(): return time.time() - T0 > CAP
p = serial.Serial(PORT, 115200, timeout=0.05)
try: p.dtr = False; p.rts = False
except Exception: pass
buf = ""
while time.time() - T0 < 60 and not over():
    d = p.read(8192)
    if d: buf += d.decode("utf-8", "replace")
    if "nsh>" in buf[-400:]: break
out = ""
for c in CMDS:
    if over(): out += "\n!!HARD-TIMEOUT before [%s]\n" % c; break
    p.write((c + "\r").encode())
    o = ""; t0 = time.time(); tq = time.time()
    while time.time() - t0 < WAIT:
        if over(): o += "\n!!HARD-TIMEOUT inside [%s]\n" % c; break
        d = p.read(8192)
        if d: o += d.decode("utf-8", "replace"); tq = time.time()

    out += "\n===[%s]===\n" % c + o

/****************************************************************************
 * apps/jixun-codec/port/jx_codec.h
 *
 * 极讯 AI Codec —— 板端封装层
 *
 * 数据流（与 PC 端 test/codec_main.c 的 send/recv 完全一致）：
 *   编码: 16kHz 单声道 int16 PCM
 *         -> encoder_forward -> en_encoder_forward -> quantizer_forward
 *         -> 量化索引 idx[]（每 token VQ_TOTAL_BITS 位，这就是空口载荷）
 *   解码: idx[] -> quantizer_to_features -> en_decoder_forward
 *         -> decoder_forward -> float PCM（[-1,1]）
 ****************************************************************************/

#ifndef __APPS_JIXUN_CODEC_PORT_JX_CODEC_H
#define __APPS_JIXUN_CODEC_PORT_JX_CODEC_H

#include <stdint.h>

/* 分段耗时（毫秒） */
typedef struct
{
  double pre_ms;        /* 编码：前处理 + encoder CNN + en_encoder 注意力 */
  double quant_ms;      /* 编码：FSQ 量化 */
  double deq_attn_ms;   /* 解码：反量化 + en_decoder 注意力 */
  double dec_ms;        /* 解码：decoder CNN */
  double total_ms;      /* 编码 + 解码 总计 */
} jx_timing_t;

extern jx_timing_t jx_last_timing;

/* 当前编译进的码率名："1k" / "3k" / "6k" */
const char *jx_rate_name(void);

/* 每 token 位数（1k=17，3k/6k=18） */
int jx_token_bits(void);

/* 编码：pcm 为 n_samples 个 16kHz 单声道样本（int16）。
 * 成功返回 0，并置 *out_idx（调用方 free）、*out_ntok（token 数）、
 * *out_Tt（帧数，= padded_samples / HOP_LENGTH）。 */
int jx_encode(const int16_t *pcm, int n_samples,
              int64_t **out_idx, int *out_ntok, int *out_Tt);

/* 解码：把 Tt 帧的 idx 还原成 origT 个浮点样本（[-1,1]）。
 * 成功返回 0，*out_pcm 由调用方 free。 */
int jx_decode(const int64_t *idx, int Tt, int origT, float **out_pcm);

/****************************************************************************
 * 2026-09-18：24ms 小包流式编解码（相对区间语义）
 *
 * 判据已改：**不再要求与整段批处理逐位一致**。流式 codec 本来就按相对区间
 * 处理，输出与批处理不同是正常的 —— 实测也支持这点：分块结果对左侧回看 L、
 * 右侧余量 R 都近乎免疫，说明模型只在乎相对窗内的结构，不在乎绝对位置。
 *
 * 参数（4 帧/包）：
 *   一帧         = HOP_LENGTH = 96 样本 = 6ms
 *   一个包       = 4 帧 = 384 样本 = 24ms
 *   一个 token   = 18 bit，4 token = 72 bit = 9 字节整
 *   一个注意力窗 = 400 帧 = 100 包 = 2400ms = 900 字节
 *
 * 为什么 4 帧不是 3 帧(18ms)：400÷4=100 整除，包边界能对齐注意力窗格；
 * 400÷3 除不尽，掩码相位永远差一点。且 4×18bit 正好 9 字节。
 *
 * 语义：每包在固定长度滚动缓冲里算，缓冲 = 1 个注意力窗(400帧) + 右侧
 * 卷积 halo，只取最新 4 帧输出。卷积局部、归一化走滑动窗、注意力用对齐后的
 * 局部帧号 —— 全部相对区间。
 ****************************************************************************/

#define JX_PKT_FRAMES        4
#define JX_PKT_SAMPLES       (JX_PKT_FRAMES * HOP_LENGTH)   /* 384 = 24ms */
#define JX_NET_WINDOW_FRAMES 400                            /* = EN_WINDOW */
#define JX_PKT_BITS          (JX_PKT_FRAMES * 18)           /* 72 bit */
#define JX_PKT_BYTES         (JX_PKT_BITS / 8)              /* 9 字节 */

struct jx_stream_s;

struct jx_stream_s *jx_stream_open(int halo_samples);
void jx_stream_close(struct jx_stream_s *st);

/* 喂一个 24ms 包（JX_PKT_SAMPLES 个样本）。成功时输出本包的 token
 *（JX_PKT_FRAMES 个，18bit 有效）与对应解码 PCM（JX_PKT_SAMPLES 个 float）。
 * tok_out 长度 >= JX_PKT_FRAMES；pcm_out 长度 >= JX_PKT_SAMPLES。
 * 返回 0 成功，<0 失败。 */
int jx_stream_feed(struct jx_stream_s *st, const int16_t *pkt,

thinking: Interesting: COM23 is not the same firmware (partition table differs), maybe an ESP32-S3 with different app. It booted but no NSH output? It might be an ESP-IDF app, not NuttX. So COM23 isn't the second Jixun board? Wait second board MAC 80:b5:4e:cd:0f:8c previously booted same NuttX. But now partition table shows ota_0 size 0x200000 not 0x600000. Maybe different firmware flashed in the meantime? It might be another board with a different app. We may need reflash COM23 with r200. The board previously identified as 80:b5:4e:cd:0f:8c on COM23 but now boot partition table 0x200000 and app size 698KB; maybe it's not NuttX. Could be that COM23 refers to another device or board changed. We should flash r200 to COM23 too. But caution: the command docs say only write 0x10000, no erase. Partition table at 0x8000 remains from different project; if we write r200 at 0x10000 but partition table maybe expects app size 2MB, our image is 3.8MB and may extend into ota_1 offset 0x210000. That could be problematic. Need reflash full partition+bootloader? The dual board package likely has `_flash` and instructions for flashing all partitions. However previous board COM23 had same NuttX partition table; perhaps now it was reflashed with something else. To get same r200, we might need flash bootloader, partition table, app. Could figure from earlier `_wifi4_COM23.log`: it had bootloader from ESP-IDF and partition sizes 0x600000, app segments ~4.4MB. That was the same NuttX image. Now COM23 bootloader partition shows 0x200000, app ~698KB, so different. Could be board changed/connected. Maybe it's a different firmware from plant companion? We can safely reflash NuttX full image? Need bootloader and partition table. The r200 `nuttx.bin` created by `elf2image` is the app only. Partition table/bootloader likely in external flash from previous. If partition table differs, app won't work correctly, but it did boot a different app. We can reflash just app at 0x10000; partition table says app partition at 0x10000 length 0x200000, so a 3.8MB image would overflow into the next partition at 0x210000. esptool write-flash can write across partition boundaries; partition table not enforce, but bootloader will load only 2MB? It might fail. Better to restore bootloader+partition table for NuttX from a release package. Need find exact flash images for the board. Search `_flash` dirs and packages for `bootloader.bin`, `partition-table.bin`. Maybe NuttX uses an ESP-IDF bootloader at 0x0 and partition table at 0x8000. The project packaging perhaps includes bootloader and partition table. Search.

## 3. bootloader 说明（重要，踩过坑）

`01_固件/` 里有三份 bootloader：

| 文件 | sha256 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `bootloader_板1_A.bin` | `CE795FF4...FA685` | 板1 的，正常 |

## 二、根因一：板2 的 bootloader 让 PSRAM 进不了堆（本轮最大发现）

### 现象
板2 用同一份固件时：

```
nsh> free
      total       used       free    maxused    maxfree  nused  nfree name
     114188      61868      52320      62248      52304    155      2 Umem
```
只有 **114 KB 内部 RAM**，一整块 PSRAM（8 MB）不见了。后果就是
`jixun net tx` 直接 `[ERR] 录音缓冲分配失败`（录音缓冲要 2 秒 x 16000 x 2B = 64 KB）。

### 定位链路（全部有硬证据）
1. `jixun codec mem` 报 `[2] PSRAM : 1MB 分配失败`、`[6] 权重块 FLASH(XIP)` 后面
   `[10]~[15]` 全部“分配失败”。
2. 板2 上 `jixun peek 3fc96680 8` 读 PSRAM 映射全局量（v111/v112 符号）：
   ```
   3fc96680: 3e000000 3e000000 00000001 00800000
             ^^^^end  ^^^^start  inited=1  size=8MB
   ```
   PSRAM **初始化是成功的**（8 MB），但“可分配区间” **start == end == 0x3e000000**，
   长度 0 → `xtensa_add_region()` 里 `size = 0` → 一块都不进堆。
3. `nuttx/arch/xtensa/src/esp32s3/esp32s3_spiram.c: mmu_valid_space()` 从 MMU 表**末尾往前**
   找第一个“已被占用”的项，然后认为它**上面**全是空的。板2 上 MMU 表最后一项被占：
   ```
   nsh> jixun peek 600c57f0 4      (MMU 表基址 DR_REG_MMU_TABLE = 0x600c5000)
     600c57f0: 00004000 00004000 00004000 00000001
                                            ^^^^^^^^ entry 511 = 有效
   ```
   即 vaddr `0x3dff0000` 被映射到 flash 物理页 1（`0x10000`，正是 ota_0 应用起点）。
4. **谁留下的**：不是 NuttX（`esp32s3_spiflash.c: esp32s3_mmap()` 是**从低往高**找空闲项的）。
   是 bootloader。对比两板 0x0..0x8000：
   ```
   板1: ESP-IDF 1559b630        编译 2026-08-24   -> 正常
   板2: ESP-IDF v5.5.5-dirty    编译 2026-08-17   -> 顶端残留映射
   32 KB 中有 29010 字节不同
   ```

### 修复（按用户指示：板2 直接刷成板1 的）
```
python -m esptool --port COM23 --baud 921600 --after hard-reset write-flash 0x0 _boot_b1.bin
```
刷完回读校验：板2 的 0x0..0x8000 与板1 **sha256 完全一致**，`free` 恢复 8.5 MB。

### 归因实验（谁真正起了作用）
把**不含** NuttX 加固补丁的旧固件 `nuttx_v111.bin` 刷到换过 bootloader 的板2：
- `free` = 8,502,796 / 空闲 8,440,920 ✓ PSRAM 正常
- `peek 600c57f0 4` → `4000 4000 4000 4000`，entry 511 已变成 invalid ✓

**结论：换 bootloader 就完全修好了**，NuttX 那处改动不是必需的。

### 顺带加的加固（非必需，可回退）
`nuttx/arch/xtensa/src/esp32s3/esp32s3_spiram.c` 的 `mmu_valid_space()` 改成
“找**最高的、长度足够放下 PSRAM 的连续空洞**”，而不是“第一个占用项之上全部算空闲”。
目的：以后万一再拿到带同款 bootloader 的板子，PSRAM 不会**静默消失**。
- 备份：`snapshots/v112_psramfix_20260914/esp32s3_spiram.c`、同目录 `esp32s3_spiram.c.bak_psramfix`
- 对板1 行为**无影响**（仍是把 PSRAM 映射到 `0x3c440000`，8 MB 全部进堆）。
- 要回退：把 `.bak_psramfix` 覆盖回去重编即可。

## 三、根因二：`jixun net tx/rx` 参数错位一档

`main/jx_main.c` 里 `main()` 先按 `argv[1]` 分发子命令，因此 `jixun net tx <IP> <秒> <端口>`
实际是 `argv[0]=jixun, argv[1]=net, argv[2]=tx, argv[3]=IP, argv[4]=秒, argv[5]=端口`，
但函数里按 `argv[2]` 开始取值 → 全部左移一档。

| 命令行 | 错的表现 | 现在 |
|---|---|---|
| `jixun net tx 192.168.3.6 2 45678` | `-> tx:2`，秒数被 `atoi("192.168.3.6")=192` 截成 5 | `-> 192.168.3.6:45678`，秒数 2 |
| `jixun net rx 45678 120` | `端口 0，最多 45678 秒`（等于永久阻塞） | `端口 45678，最多 120 秒` |

改动（`main/jx_main.c`，行号见文件）：
```
1746  if (argc < 4)                                   // 原 argc < 3
1752  ip = argv[3];                                   // 原 argv[2]
1753  if (argc >= 5) { secs = atoi(argv[4]); }        // 原 >=4 / argv[3]
1754  if (argc >= 6) { port = atoi(argv[5]); }        // 原 >=5 / argv[4]
1857  if (argc >= 4) { port = atoi(argv[3]); }        // 原 >=3 / argv[2]
1858  if (argc >= 5) { timeout = atoi(argv[4]); }     // 原 >=4 / argv[3]
```
备份：`jx_main.c.bak_netarg`（同目录）。

  I (787) wifi:config NVS flash: disabled
  ```
  意思是 WiFi 驱动**不把 MAC 存/读 NVS**，每次都从 eFuse 取 → **同一份固件刷 N 块板卡，
  会得到 N 个不同 MAC**，不会出现“同 MAC 注册 WiFi 失败”。

### 如果哪天真要软件改 MAC（现在用不上，留个口子）
- 接口在 `libnet80211.a` 里：`esp_wifi_set_mac(ifx, mac)`、`wifi_reset_mac`、`wifi_set_mac_process`；
  声明在 `esp_wifi.h`（约 767 行）。
- NuttX 侧适配在 `nuttx/arch/xtensa/src/esp32s3/esp32s3_wifi_adapter.c`：
  `esp_wifi_read_mac()` 调 `esp_read_mac()`。要做的话，在 `esp_wifi_start()` **之前**
  调一次 `esp_wifi_set_mac(WIFI_IF_STA, mac)`，再挂个 `jixun mac set xx:xx:xx:xx:xx:xx`
  命令（顺便把值存 NVS / SD，重启后仍生效）即可。
- 注意：本地管理位置 1 的地址（首字节 `02/06/0a/0e/12/.../82`）是合法的自定义 MAC，
  板1 现在的 `82:...` 就属于这一类。

## 七、构建配置里最容易踩的坑

`nuttx/.config` 有三处**必须**和当前一致，否则会回归成已知故障：

| 配置 | 值 | 不改的后果 |
|---|---|---|
| `CONFIG_IDLETHREAD_STACKSIZE` | **8192**（曾 2048） | 启动栈就是 IDLE 栈；PSRAM 调优函数要 2176 B 栈，2048 会**栈溢出把 1 KB `a5ff005a` 图案糊进 .bss**，砸掉 WiFi 的 `ctx`/`g_misc_nvs` → 一联网就 PANIC（上一轮定位的根因） |
| `CONFIG_ESP32S3_WIFI_SCAN_RESULT_SIZE` | 4096 | 扫描结果缓冲区不够 |
| `CONFIG_ESPRESSIF/ESP32S3_FLASH_MODE_QIO` | QIO | 退回 DIO，flash 读变慢 |
| `CONFIG_XTENSA_CP_INITSET` | 0x00ff | 协处理器（PIE 向量指令）使能不全 |

已在**本轮同步回** `boards/xtensa/esp32s3/esp32s3-box/configs/openvela/defconfig`
（原文件备份 `defconfig.bak_v112`），避免以后从 defconfig 重建时又退回 2048。

## 八、遗留问题（下一步）

1. **实时性（第一优先级）**：端到端 17.6 s，目标 1 s 级。
   现状 int8 路径：1 秒音频 8380 ms（RTF 8.70）；算子级 conv1d 5220 / conv_unit 6870 /
   first_block 3360 / legacy_unit 2730 / local_transformer 2050 ms。
   瓶颈=访存 + 逐元素开销（PSRAM ~50 MB/s），未完成的量化 prologue/epilogue 约 1.85 s/秒音频。
2. **录音时长 > 3 秒会 `[CONV] realloc 384000 floats 失败`**，演示目前必须用 2 秒。
3. 内部 RAM 余量仍紧（`jixun memhint` ~30~45 KB）。已批准“只保留语音 + WiFi”，
   可砍 LVGL/LCD/触摸/相机/USB-serial/BT 腾出 ≥64 KB。注意 IDLE 栈 2048→8192 本身多吃 6 KB。
4. `set JX_PEER <对端IP>` 存对端地址，省得每次敲 IP（可选）。

最有利于流水线的是**混合方案**：

```text
网络传输：继续用 24ms 小包
模型推理：累积 8～16 个包再算一次
播放：用抖动缓冲，不在代码里等每一包
```

推荐参数：

| 环节 | 建议 |
|---|---|
| 空口包 | 24ms，9 字节 index |
| 编码批大小 | 8 包 = 192ms，或 16 包 = 384ms |
| 接收抖动缓冲 | 3～5 包，约 72～120ms |
| 播放缓冲 | 初始 2～3 个推理批，约 400～600ms |
| 传输方式 | UDP 序号 + 去重 + 轻量重传/FEC |
| 交互模式 | 当前算力下优先 PTT，不建议全双工 |

这样做的原因是：

- **24ms 网络包**保证丢包恢复细、重传代价低、控制信息及时。
- **192～384ms 推理批**把卷积 halo、量化 epilogue、内存分配的固定成本摊掉。按外推，192ms 一批大约能把小包路径的 `12s/s` 压到 `4.5～5s/s`，提升两倍以上。
- **抖动缓冲**把网络抖动与模型计算抖动隔开，接收端不会因为一包迟到就停播。
- **播放缓冲**负责吸收“解码时快时慢”的波动，不会每收一包就阻塞一次。

但有个硬限制：即便用 192～384ms 批处理，当前整机 RTF 仍在 `4～5` 左右，也就是 1 秒语音还要算 4～5 秒。流水线能改善连续性、减少卡顿感，但**不能把全双工变成实时**。适合当前阶段的是：

```text
PTT 半双工
按住说 1～2 秒
松开后编码、发送、后台解码
解码完一次播放
```

如果以后把单包或小批计算压到 `RTF < 1`，再把这个混合方案切成全双工：

```text
麦克风 -> 192ms 编码批 -> 24ms index 小包 -> UDP
-> 抖动缓冲 -> 192ms 解码批 -> 播放缓冲 -> 喇叭
```

一句话：**网络走 24ms 小包，模型走 192～384ms 批次，播放走缓冲队列**。这是兼顾传输体验和效率的形态；但真正实时的前提仍是 RTF 必须小于 1。

**整体结论**

目前已经证明“话音采集 → 语义编码成 index → 网络传输 → 解码播放”链路是通的，网络也不是瓶颈。真正卡住的是 **ESP32-S3 上的编码/解码计算量，以及长上下文流式状态没有真正实现**。

**已验证成果**

- 权重、C 推理代码和双板包都已补齐。
- 3kbps 端到端 PC 对照通过，golden 误差在 `3e-6～6e-6`。
- 修过 1kbps `inject` 的堆溢出。
- BER/PESQ 曲线已跑出：3% 误码时 PESQ 约 `1.9`，原报名文案里的“30% 误码仍 MOS>3.0”不成立。
- 24ms 小包流式已经打通，内存墙解决，token 和 PCM 都能稳定产出。
- 编码侧注意力已做 K/V 缓存；动态位置偏置表已复用；默认 128 帧编码窗口、4 帧解码窗口。
- 24ms 路径从早期 `746ms/包` 降到约 `289ms/包`。
- 100 包稳态实测约 `289.2ms/包`，但相对 24ms 预算仍慢约 12 倍。

**质量与延迟实测**

| 方案 | 首批延迟 | 听感 |
|---|---:|---|
| 1 秒整块编解码 | 说话结束后约 `3.7s` 计算，再加播放 | 之前清晰度可接受 |
| 24ms 逐包流式 | 首包约 `0.3～0.6s` | 有声音，但断续、瞬态明显 |
| 4 包=96ms 一批 | 约 `0.68s` | 有声音，音质差 |
| 8 包=192ms 一批 | 约 `1.14s` | 块更长，但空档仍很大 |
| 16 包=384ms 一批 | 约 `2.39s` | 延迟太大，体验更差 |
| 400 帧完整上下文 + 128 token 解码 | 约 `3.38s` | 上下文更完整，但速度不可接受 |

`loop 2` 完整块闭环实测是：说完后约 `8.48s` 出声，从开始说话算约 `10.5s`。这说明只要走完整块，音质能保住，但实时性完全不够。

**根因**

1. 模型原生需要约 2.4 秒注意力上下文，当前流式方案把它截断成 128 帧甚至更短，真实语音会出现破碎和瞬态。
2. 每 24ms 就重新启动一次模型，卷积 halo、量化 prologue/epilogue、内存分配等固定开销被放大约 40 倍。
3. 解码器被反复重置，批与批之间没有真正的注意力、卷积和归一化状态，导致“哒哒”而不是连续语音。
4. 4 倍播放增益会造成削波；1 倍增益又有信号偏弱的问题，但不能靠增益解决上下文缺失。
5. 纯 FP32 路径更慢，实测约 `1016ms/包`，不能靠关掉 int8 提速。

**当前判断**

- **网络小包传输不是问题**。3kbps 下 24ms 包只有 9 字节，UDP 完全可以承载。
- **当前代码不能同时做到高质量和实时**。24ms 小包能出数，但质量差；1 秒整块音质可接受，但延迟约 3.7 倍实时。
- **混合方案不是银弹**。4/8/16 包批处理只是把固定开销摊薄，不能解决长上下文缺失和总体算力不足。
- 真正要走实时，必须实现完整的流式状态缓存：编码/解码注意力 K/V、卷积 halo、instance norm 滑动状态；或者换更轻的解码模型/声码器。
- 如果演示优先保质量，建议使用 1 秒整块或 PTT 模式；如果演示优先低延迟，必须先接受当前音质，或把解码迁到 PC/服务器。

**当前资产**

- 调试总结：[实时流水线文档](E:/jixuncodec_prj/_REALTIME_24MS_PIPELINE_20260918.md:1)
- 最近备份：`E:\jixuncodec_prj\_backup\r211_pre_batchtest_20260918`
- 当前可用回退固件：`nuttx_r210.bin`、`nuttx_r208.bin`
- 当前实验固件：`nuttx_r213.bin`
- COM23 已按要求释放，后续不要把它作为自动测试目标。

**下一步优先级**

1. 保质量：回到 1 秒整块/PTT 方案，先把可演示链路定住。
2. 保实时：实现真正的编码器和解码器流式缓存，不再采用“短包重新解码”。
3. 要大幅突破：必须做更轻的模型/声码器，或把解码计算迁到 PC/服务器；仅靠 ESP32-S3 当前模型和现有内核，24ms 连续实时没有可行余量。

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: board_touchscreen_initialize
 *
 * Description:
 *   Initialize touchpad.
 *
 * Input Parameters:
 *   None.
 *
 * Returned Value:
 *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno value on failure.
 *
 ****************************************************************************/
int board_touchscreen_initialize(void)
{
  int ret;
  struct gt911_dev_s *dev = &g_gt911_dev;

  /* Step 1: Reset+INT sequence to set I2C address
   * According to GT911 datasheet:
   * 1. RST output LOW
   * 2. INT output LOW (hold >100μs)
   * 3. RST output HIGH (release reset)
   * 4. Wait >5ms
   * 5. INT switch to floating input (external pull-up makes it HIGH)
   */

  /* Configure RST (GPIO48) and INT (GPIO3) as outputs */

  esp32s3_configgpio(48, OUTPUT);  /* RST */
  esp32s3_configgpio(3, OUTPUT);   /* INT */

  /* RST = LOW, INT = LOW */

  esp32s3_gpiowrite(48, false);  /* RST = LOW */
  esp32s3_gpiowrite(3, false);   /* INT = LOW */
  up_udelay(200);  /* Wait >100μs */

  /* RST = HIGH (release reset) */

  esp32s3_gpiowrite(48, true);   /* RST = HIGH */
  up_mdelay(10);  /* Wait >5ms */

  /* INT switch to floating input (external pull-up) */

  esp32s3_configgpio(3, INPUT);  /* INT = floating input */
  up_mdelay(50);  /* Wait for GT911 to initialize */

  /* Step 2: Initialize I2C bus */

  dev->i2c = esp32s3_i2cbus_initialize(TOUCHSCEEN_I2C);
  if (!dev->i2c)
    {
      printf("[Touch] ERROR: Failed to initialize I2C port %d\n",
             TOUCHSCEEN_I2C);
      return -ENODEV;
    }

name: diagnosing-bugs
description: Diagnosis loop for hard bugs and performance regressions. Use when the user says "diagnose"/"debug this", or reports something broken/throwing/failing/slow.

# Diagnosing Bugs

A discipline for hard bugs. Skip phases only when explicitly justified.

When exploring the codebase, read `CONTEXT.md` (if it exists) to get a clear mental model of the relevant modules, and check ADRs in the area you're touching.

## Redact

This skill has you show commands, outputs and captured artifacts. **Redact every secret first**: write `<REDACTED>` in its place. Build loops against env vars, so the credential stays in the environment rather than in what you show. Captured artifacts carry auth headers: quote only the lines that carry the signal.

If the redacted output is not enough to diagnose the bug, say so and ask the user.

## Phase 1: Build a feedback loop

**This is the skill.** Everything else is mechanical. If you have a **tight** pass/fail signal for the bug (one that goes red on _this_ bug), you will find the cause; bisection, hypothesis-testing, and instrumentation all just consume it. If you don't have one, no amount of staring at code will save you.

Spend disproportionate effort here. **Be aggressive. Be creative. Refuse to give up.**

### Ways to construct one, in roughly this order

1. **Failing test** at whatever seam reaches the bug: unit, integration, e2e.
2. **Curl / HTTP script** against a running dev server.
3. **CLI invocation** with a fixture input, diffing stdout against a known-good snapshot.
4. **Headless browser script** (Playwright / Puppeteer) that drives the UI and asserts on DOM/console/network.
5. **Replay a captured trace.** Save a real network request / payload / event log to disk; replay it through the code path in isolation.
6. **Throwaway harness.** Spin up a minimal subset of the system (one service, mocked deps) that exercises the bug code path with a single function call.
7. **Property / fuzz loop.** If the bug is "sometimes wrong output", run 1000 random inputs and look for the failure mode.
8. **Bisection harness.** If the bug appeared between two known states (commit, dataset, version), automate "boot at state X, check, repeat" so you can `git bisect run` it.
9. **Differential loop.** Run the same input through old-version vs new-version (or two configs) and diff outputs.
10. **HITL bash script.** Last resort. If a human must click, drive _them_ with `scripts/hitl-loop.template.sh` so the loop is still structured. Captured output feeds back to you.

Build the right feedback loop, and the bug is 90% fixed.

### Tighten the loop

Treat the loop as a product. Once you have _a_ loop, **tighten** it:

- Can I make it faster? (Cache setup, skip unrelated init, narrow the test scope.)
- Can I make the signal sharper? (Assert on the specific symptom, not "didn't crash".)
- Can I make it more deterministic? (Pin time, seed RNG, isolate filesystem, freeze network.)

A 30-second flaky loop is barely better than no loop; a 2-second deterministic one is tight, a debugging superpower.

### Non-deterministic bugs

The goal is not a clean repro but a **higher reproduction rate**. Loop the trigger 100×, parallelise, add stress, narrow timing windows, inject sleeps. A 50%-flake bug is debuggable; 1% is not, so keep raising the rate until it's debuggable.

### When you genuinely cannot build a loop

Stop and say so explicitly. List what you tried. Ask the user for: (a) access to whatever environment reproduces it, (b) a redacted captured artifact (HAR file, log dump, core dump, screen recording with timestamps), or (c) permission to add temporary production instrumentation. Do **not** proceed to hypothesise without a loop.

### Completion criterion: a tight loop that goes red

Phase 1 is done when the loop is **tight** and **red-capable**: you can name **one command** (a script path, a test invocation, a curl) that you have **already run at least once** (show the invocation and its output, redacted), and that is:

- [ ] **Red-capable**: it drives the actual bug code path and asserts the **user's exact symptom**, so it can go red on this bug and green once fixed. Not "runs without erroring"; it must be able to _catch this specific bug_.
- [ ] **Deterministic**: same verdict every run (flaky bugs: a pinned, high reproduction rate, per above).
- [ ] **Fast**: seconds, not minutes.
- [ ] **Agent-runnable**: you can run it unattended; a human in the loop only via `scripts/hitl-loop.template.sh`.

If you catch yourself reading code to build a theory before this command exists, **stop: jumping straight to a hypothesis is the exact failure this skill prevents.** No red-capable command, no Phase 2.

## Phase 2: Reproduce + minimise

Run the loop. Watch it go red as the bug appears.

Confirm:

- [ ] The loop produces the failure mode the **user** described, not a different failure that happens to be nearby. Wrong bug = wrong fix.
- [ ] The failure is reproducible across multiple runs (or, for non-deterministic bugs, reproducible at a high enough rate to debug against).
- [ ] You have captured the exact symptom (error message, wrong output, slow timing) so later phases can verify the fix actually addresses it.

### Minimise

Once it's red, shrink the repro to the **smallest scenario that still goes red**. Cut inputs, callers, config, data, and steps **one at a time**, re-running the loop after each cut, and keep only what's load-bearing for the failure.

Why bother: a minimal repro shrinks the hypothesis space in Phase 3 (fewer moving parts left to suspect) and becomes the clean regression test in Phase 5.

Done when **every remaining element is load-bearing**: removing any one of them makes the loop go green.

Do not proceed until you have reproduced **and** minimised.

## Phase 3: Hypothesise

Generate **3–5 ranked hypotheses** before testing any of them. Single-hypothesis generation anchors on the first plausible idea.

Each hypothesis must be **falsifiable**: state the prediction it makes.

> Format: "If <X> is the cause, then <changing Y> will make the bug disappear / <changing Z> will make it worse."

If you cannot state the prediction, the hypothesis is a vibe: discard or sharpen it.

**Show the ranked list to the user before testing.** They often have domain knowledge that re-ranks instantly ("we just deployed a change to #3"), or know hypotheses they've already ruled out. Cheap checkpoint, big time saver. Don't block on it; proceed with your ranking if the user is AFK.

## Phase 4: Instrument

Each probe must map to a specific prediction from Phase 3. **Change one variable at a time.**

Tool preference:

1. **Debugger / REPL inspection** if the env supports it. One breakpoint beats ten logs.
2. **Targeted logs** at the boundaries that distinguish hypotheses.
3. Never "log everything and grep".

**Tag every debug log** with a unique prefix, e.g. `[DEBUG-a4f2]`. Cleanup at the end becomes a single grep. Untagged logs survive; tagged logs die.

**Perf branch.** For performance regressions, logs are usually wrong. Instead: establish a baseline measurement (timing harness, `performance.now()`, profiler, query plan), then bisect. Measure first, fix second.

## Phase 5: Fix + regression test

Write the regression test **before the fix**, but only if there is a **correct seam** for it.

A correct seam is one where the test exercises the **real bug pattern** as it occurs at the call site. If the only available seam is too shallow (single-caller test when the bug needs multiple callers, unit test that can't replicate the chain that triggered the bug), a regression test there gives false confidence.

**If no correct seam exists, that itself is the finding.** Note it. The codebase architecture is preventing the bug from being locked down. Flag this for the next phase.

If a correct seam exists:

1. Turn the minimised repro into a failing test at that seam.
2. Watch it fail.
3. Apply the fix.
4. Watch it pass.
5. Re-run the Phase 1 feedback loop against the original (un-minimised) scenario.

## Phase 6: Cleanup

Required before declaring done:

- [ ] Original repro no longer reproduces (re-run the Phase 1 loop)

############################################################################
# apps/jixun-codec/Makefile
#
# 极讯 AI Codec 上板验证 app
#
#   make JX_RATE=3k      # 或 1k / 6k，选择编译进固件的码率（默认 3k）
#
# 复用 plant-companion 的音频外设层（es8311/es7210/voice_agent/ai_voice）：
# 这里只加头文件搜索路径，不重复编译其源码，避免符号重复；
# 符号在最终链接时从 libapps.a 里取（plant-companion 必须处于启用状态）。
############################################################################

include $(APPDIR)/Make.defs

# ---- 码率选择（构建期）----------------------------------------------------
JX_RATE ?= 3k
JX_RATE_UC := $(shell echo $(JX_RATE) | tr a-z A-Z)

# ---- 复用上游音频层 -------------------------------------------------------
PC = $(APPDIR)/plant-companion
CFLAGS += -I$(PC)/hal
CFLAGS += -I$(PC)/components/voice_agent
CFLAGS += -I$(PC)/ai_module/ai_voice

# hal_i2s.h / hal_gpio.h 包的是 arch 的芯片头（与 plant-companion 同处理）
ifneq ($(wildcard $(TOPDIR)/arch/xtensa/src/esp32s3),)
CFLAGS += -I$(TOPDIR)/arch/xtensa/src/esp32s3
endif

# ---- 我们自己的 codec -----------------------------------------------------
CFLAGS += -Iinclude
CFLAGS += -Iport
CFLAGS += -Iweights/$(JX_RATE)
CFLAGS += -DSQM_RATE_$(JX_RATE_UC)
CFLAGS += -O3
# r81d 实测反例：-ffp-contract=off 使 3980 -> 4230 ms，已回退。
# r84 实测反例：-funroll-loops -frename-registers 使 3980 -> 4100 ms，已回退。
# r89：寄存器压力相关的调度/分配选项。反汇编证据（xtensa 交叉编译器，只编
# int8_kernels.c 后统计）：jx_linear_i8_rows 的 FP 栈溢出条数
#     基线 246 -> -fira-loop-pressure 233 -> -fweb 228 -> 两者合用 217
#     （再加 -fira-region=all 为 206，但它同时把指令数从 3587 抬到 3591）
# 这两项只影响寄存器分配与 web 分解，不改变任何表达式的求值次序 -> 数值不变。
CFLAGS += -fweb -fira-loop-pressure

# ESP32-S3 的 PIE 128-bit 向量指令（int8 点积内核用）
ifeq ($(CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_ESP32S3),y)
CFLAGS += -DJX_PIE=1
endif

# codec 核心（与 PC 端 sqcodec-light-c-v1/src 同源）
CSRCS += csrc/blocks.c
CSRCS += csrc/decoder.c
CSRCS += csrc/encoder.c
CSRCS += csrc/fsq_codec.c
CSRCS += csrc/nn_ops.c
CSRCS += csrc/quantizer.c
CSRCS += csrc/transformer.c
CSRCS += csrc/model_config.c
CSRCS += csrc/int8_kernels.c
CSRCS += csrc/jx_amax.c

# 板端封装
CSRCS += port/jx_codec.c
CSRCS += port/jx_net.c
CSRCS += port/jx_ui.c

import io, serial, sys, time
port = serial.Serial("COM4", 115200, timeout=0.2)
out = io.TextIOWrapper(sys.stdout.buffer, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
def send(cmd, wait):
    port.write((cmd + "\r").encode())
    t0 = time.time()
    while time.time() - t0 < wait:
        data = port.read(4096)
        if data:
            out.write(data.decode("utf-8", "replace")); out.flush()

time.sleep(4.0)
out.write("\n[touch-test] 屏幕出现后，请只点一次底部“图像”按钮。\n"); out.flush()
t0 = time.time(); n = 0
while time.time() - t0 < 60.0:
    data = port.read(4096)
    if data:
        n += len(data)
        out.write(data.decode("utf-8", "replace")); out.flush()
port.close()
print(f"\n--- capture {n} bytes ---")

不是产品要求每次冷启动，是我这边调试方式把 GT911 打进异常状态了。

原因有三层：

1. `esptool --after hard-reset` 只复位 ESP32-S3，不会切断触摸芯片 GT911 的供电。GT911 是独立挂在 I2C 上的芯片，重复硬复位/烧录时可能保留异常状态。
2. 我用的串口脚本打开/关闭 COM4 会触发 USB-JTAG 的复位线，等于在很短时间内连续复位，GT911 更容易卡住。
3. 真正拔插 USB 才会让整块板包括 GT911 重新上电，所以我把这个作为调试时的恢复手段。

正常使用不是这样：产品上电一次，GT911 走正常上电初始化，不需要每次点击都冷启动。只有连续烧录/反复硬复位后，才需要拔插一次。

如果你希望以后烧完固件也不用手动拔插，我可以继续做固件级恢复：在启动时对 GT911 做更长、更严格的复位序列；如果连续一段时间没有触摸上报，自动重初始化一次。这样才是正式的解决办法。

def build_charset(extra):
    chars = set()
    for i in range(0x20, 0x7F):          # ASCII 可打印
        chars.add(chr(i))
    for s in UI_TEXT:
        chars.update(s)
    if extra:
        chars.update(extra)
    chars.discard("\n")
    chars.discard("\r")
    return sorted(chars, key=ord)


def render_glyph(font, ch, w, h):
    img = Image.new("L", (w, h), 0)
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    # 用 anchor 让字形在 16x16 格里居中；ascent 基线对齐更稳
    try:
        d.text((w // 2, h // 2), ch, font=font, fill=255, anchor="mm")
    except Exception:
        d.text((0, 0), ch, font=font, fill=255)
    return img


def pack_bits(img, w, h):
    stride = (w + 7) // 8
    out = bytearray(stride * h)
    px = img.load()
    for y in range(h):
        for x in range(w):
            if px[x, y] >= 128:
                out[y * stride + (x >> 3)] |= 0x80 >> (x & 7)
    return bytes(out)

    w = h = args.size

    font = ImageFont.truetype(args.font, size=int(h * 0.94), index=args.index)

    chars = build_charset(args.extra)
    glyphs = []
    for ch in chars:

        glyphs.append((cp, pack_bits(render_glyph(font, ch, w, h), w, h)))

    glyphs.sort(key=lambda t: t[0])

    out += b"JXFN"
    out += struct.pack("<HH", w, h)
    out += struct.pack("<II", count, hdr)
    out += index
    out += blob

    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(args.out), exist_ok=True)
    with open(args.out, "wb") as f:
        f.write(out)

    print("字库: %s" % args.out)
    print("  字形 %d 个, %dx%d, %d 字节 (索引 %d + 位图 %d)"
          % (count, w, h, len(out), count * 8, len(blob)))
    print("  覆盖: ASCII 0x20-0x7E + %d 个汉字" % (count - 95))

    # 同一份数据再产出一个 C 头：const 数组只占 flash，不占 DRAM。
    # 板子的 dram0_0_seg（内部 DRAM 数据段）只剩 ~200 字节，所以字库必须

    if args.hdr:

        with open(args.hdr, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as f:
            f.write("/* 自动生成，勿手改：python -X utf8 _fontgen.py */\n")
            f.write("#ifndef __JX_FONT_BIN_H\n#define __JX_FONT_BIN_H\n\n")
            f.write("#define JX_FONT_LEN %du\n\n" % len(out))
            f.write("static const unsigned char g_jx_font[JX_FONT_LEN] =\n{\n")
            for i in range(0, len(out), 16):

## 二、根因一：板2 的 bootloader 让 PSRAM 进不了堆（本轮最大发现）

### 现象
板2 用同一份固件时：

```
nsh> free
      total       used       free    maxused    maxfree  nused  nfree name
     114188      61868      52320      62248      52304    155      2 Umem
```
只有 **114 KB 内部 RAM**，一整块 PSRAM（8 MB）不见了。后果就是
`jixun net tx` 直接 `[ERR] 录音缓冲分配失败`（录音缓冲要 2 秒 x 16000 x 2B = 64 KB）。

### 定位链路（全部有硬证据）
1. `jixun codec mem` 报 `[2] PSRAM : 1MB 分配失败`、`[6] 权重块 FLASH(XIP)` 后面
   `[10]~[15]` 全部“分配失败”。
2. 板2 上 `jixun peek 3fc96680 8` 读 PSRAM 映射全局量（v111/v112 符号）：
   ```
   3fc96680: 3e000000 3e000000 00000001 00800000
             ^^^^end  ^^^^start  inited=1  size=8MB
   ```
   PSRAM **初始化是成功的**（8 MB），但“可分配区间” **start == end == 0x3e000000**，
   长度 0 → `xtensa_add_region()` 里 `size = 0` → 一块都不进堆。
3. `nuttx/arch/xtensa/src/esp32s3/esp32s3_spiram.c: mmu_valid_space()` 从 MMU 表**末尾往前**
   找第一个“已被占用”的项，然后认为它**上面**全是空的。板2 上 MMU 表最后一项被占：
   ```
   nsh> jixun peek 600c57f0 4      (MMU 表基址 DR_REG_MMU_TABLE = 0x600c5000)
     600c57f0: 00004000 00004000 00004000 00000001
                                            ^^^^^^^^ entry 511 = 有效
   ```
   即 vaddr `0x3dff0000` 被映射到 flash 物理页 1（`0x10000`，正是 ota_0 应用起点）。
4. **谁留下的**：不是 NuttX（`esp32s3_spiflash.c: esp32s3_mmap()` 是**从低往高**找空闲项的）。
   是 bootloader。对比两板 0x0..0x8000：
   ```
   板1: ESP-IDF 1559b630        编译 2026-08-24   -> 正常
   板2: ESP-IDF v5.5.5-dirty    编译 2026-08-17   -> 顶端残留映射
   32 KB 中有 29010 字节不同
   ```

### 修复（按用户指示：板2 直接刷成板1 的）
```
python -m esptool --port COM23 --baud 921600 --after hard-reset write-flash 0x0 _boot_b1.bin
```
刷完回读校验：板2 的 0x0..0x8000 与板1 **sha256 完全一致**，`free` 恢复 8.5 MB。

### 归因实验（谁真正起了作用）
把**不含** NuttX 加固补丁的旧固件 `nuttx_v111.bin` 刷到换过 bootloader 的板2：
- `free` = 8,502,796 / 空闲 8,440,920 ✓ PSRAM 正常
- `peek 600c57f0 4` → `4000 4000 4000 4000`，entry 511 已变成 invalid ✓

**结论：换 bootloader 就完全修好了**，NuttX 那处改动不是必需的。

### 顺带加的加固（非必需，可回退）
`nuttx/arch/xtensa/src/esp32s3/esp32s3_spiram.c` 的 `mmu_valid_space()` 改成
“找**最高的、长度足够放下 PSRAM 的连续空洞**”，而不是“第一个占用项之上全部算空闲”。
目的：以后万一再拿到带同款 bootloader 的板子，PSRAM 不会**静默消失**。
- 备份：`snapshots/v112_psramfix_20260914/esp32s3_spiram.c`、同目录 `esp32s3_spiram.c.bak_psramfix`
- 对板1 行为**无影响**（仍是把 PSRAM 映射到 `0x3c440000`，8 MB 全部进堆）。
- 要回退：把 `.bak_psramfix` 覆盖回去重编即可。

## 三、根因二：`jixun net tx/rx` 参数错位一档

`main/jx_main.c` 里 `main()` 先按 `argv[1]` 分发子命令，因此 `jixun net tx <IP> <秒> <端口>`
实际是 `argv[0]=jixun, argv[1]=net, argv[2]=tx, argv[3]=IP, argv[4]=秒, argv[5]=端口`，
但函数里按 `argv[2]` 开始取值 → 全部左移一档。

| 命令行 | 错的表现 | 现在 |
|---|---|---|
| `jixun net tx 192.168.3.6 2 45678` | `-> tx:2`，秒数被 `atoi("192.168.3.6")=192` 截成 5 | `-> 192.168.3.6:45678`，秒数 2 |
| `jixun net rx 45678 120` | `端口 0，最多 45678 秒`（等于永久阻塞） | `端口 45678，最多 120 秒` |

改动（`main/jx_main.c`，行号见文件）：
```
1746  if (argc < 4)                                   // 原 argc < 3
1752  ip = argv[3];                                   // 原 argv[2]
1753  if (argc >= 5) { secs = atoi(argv[4]); }        // 原 >=4 / argv[3]
1754  if (argc >= 6) { port = atoi(argv[5]); }        // 原 >=5 / argv[4]
1857  if (argc >= 4) { port = atoi(argv[3]); }        // 原 >=3 / argv[2]
1858  if (argc >= 5) { timeout = atoi(argv[4]); }     // 原 >=4 / argv[3]
```
备份：`jx_main.c.bak_netarg`（同目录）。

## 四、MAC 地址问题（你问的那条）

### 结论：**不需要改，也不可能撞 MAC**
- 每颗 ESP32-S3 的 MAC 是**出厂烧在 eFuse 里的**，单板唯一，读出来就是自己的。
- 实测两板：`80:b5:4e:cc:0a:a0` vs `80:b5:4e:cd:0f:8c`（同 OUI `80:b5:4e`，序列号不同）。
  OS 侧：`82:b5:4e:cc:0a:42` vs `80:b5:4e:cd:0f:8c`，同样不同。
- 启动日志里有一行很关键：
  ```
  I (787) wifi:config NVS flash: disabled
  ```
  意思是 WiFi 驱动**不把 MAC 存/读 NVS**，每次都从 eFuse 取 → **同一份固件刷 N 块板卡，
  会得到 N 个不同 MAC**，不会出现“同 MAC 注册 WiFi 失败”。

### 如果哪天真要软件改 MAC（现在用不上，留个口子）
- 接口在 `libnet80211.a` 里：`esp_wifi_set_mac(ifx, mac)`、`wifi_reset_mac`、`wifi_set_mac_process`；
  声明在 `esp_wifi.h`（约 767 行）。
- NuttX 侧适配在 `nuttx/arch/xtensa/src/esp32s3/esp32s3_wifi_adapter.c`：
  `esp_wifi_read_mac()` 调 `esp_read_mac()`。要做的话，在 `esp_wifi_start()` **之前**
  调一次 `esp_wifi_set_mac(WIFI_IF_STA, mac)`，再挂个 `jixun mac set xx:xx:xx:xx:xx:xx`
  命令（顺便把值存 NVS / SD，重启后仍生效）即可。
- 注意：本地管理位置 1 的地址（首字节 `02/06/0a/0e/12/.../82`）是合法的自定义 MAC，
  板1 现在的 `82:...` 就属于这一类。

## 七、构建配置里最容易踩的坑

`nuttx/.config` 有三处**必须**和当前一致，否则会回归成已知故障：

| 配置 | 值 | 不改的后果 |
|---|---|---|
| `CONFIG_IDLETHREAD_STACKSIZE` | **8192**（曾 2048） | 启动栈就是 IDLE 栈；PSRAM 调优函数要 2176 B 栈，2048 会**栈溢出把 1 KB `a5ff005a` 图案糊进 .bss**，砸掉 WiFi 的 `ctx`/`g_misc_nvs` → 一联网就 PANIC（上一轮定位的根因） |
| `CONFIG_ESP32S3_WIFI_SCAN_RESULT_SIZE` | 4096 | 扫描结果缓冲区不够 |
| `CONFIG_ESPRESSIF/ESP32S3_FLASH_MODE_QIO` | QIO | 退回 DIO，flash 读变慢 |
| `CONFIG_XTENSA_CP_INITSET` | 0x00ff | 协处理器（PIE 向量指令）使能不全 |

已在**本轮同步回** `boards/xtensa/esp32s3/esp32s3-box/configs/openvela/defconfig`
（原文件备份 `defconfig.bak_v112`），避免以后从 defconfig 重建时又退回 2048。

## 八、遗留问题（下一步）

1. **实时性（第一优先级）**：端到端 17.6 s，目标 1 s 级。
   现状 int8 路径：1 秒音频 8380 ms（RTF 8.70）；算子级 conv1d 5220 / conv_unit 6870 /
   first_block 3360 / legacy_unit 2730 / local_transformer 2050 ms。
   瓶颈=访存 + 逐元素开销（PSRAM ~50 MB/s），未完成的量化 prologue/epilogue 约 1.85 s/秒音频。
2. **录音时长 > 3 秒会 `[CONV] realloc 384000 floats 失败`**，演示目前必须用 2 秒。
3. 内部 RAM 余量仍紧（`jixun memhint` ~30~45 KB）。已批准“只保留语音 + WiFi”，
   可砍 LVGL/LCD/触摸/相机/USB-serial/BT 腾出 ≥64 KB。注意 IDLE 栈 2048→8192 本身多吃 6 KB。
4. `set JX_PEER <对端IP>` 存对端地址，省得每次敲 IP（可选）。

/****************************************************************************
 * apps/jixun-codec/port/jx_net.h
 *
 * 极讯 AI Codec —— 双板语音通信（WiFi/UDP）
 *
 * 数据面：编码器输出的量化索引 idx[]（每 token VQ_TOTAL_BITS 位）
 *         = 训练好的"话音语义 index"，直接当空口载荷。
 *         2 秒 3kbps 音频 ≈ 334 token × 18 bit = 752 字节，一个 UDP 包就能装下。
 *
 * 包格式（定长 40 字节小端头 + 载荷分片，分片大小 JX_NET_CHUNK）：
 *   magic 'J','X','C','1' | ver | rate | bits | ntok | tt | origT |
 *   seq | ttl | payload_bytes | crc32(payload)
 *
 * 可靠性：局域网内不做重传协议，直接整包重复 JX_NET_REPEAT 次（20ms 间隔），
 *         接收端按 seq 去重。丢包率 <1% 的场景够用，也便于现场看日志。
 ****************************************************************************/

#ifndef __APPS_JIXUN_CODEC_PORT_JX_NET_H
#define __APPS_JIXUN_CODEC_PORT_JX_NET_H

#include <stdint.h>

#define JX_NET_MAGIC      0x3143584au   /* "JXC1" 小端 */
#define JX_NET_VER        2
#define JX_NET_PORT_DEF   45678
#define JX_NET_CHUNK      1024          /* 每次 sendto 的载荷字节（含头 <1500 MTU） */
#define JX_NET_REPEAT     3
#define JX_NET_HDR_LEN    48

/* 包头（必须打包成 40 字节，字段顺序即线序） */
typedef struct
{
  uint32_t magic;         /* 0  JX_NET_MAGIC */
  uint16_t ver;           /* 4  JX_NET_VER  */
  uint16_t rate_id;       /* 6  0=1k 1=3k 2=6k */
  uint16_t bits;          /* 8  每 token 位数 */
  uint16_t reserved;      /* 10 */
  uint32_t ntok;          /* 12 token 总数 */
  uint32_t tt;            /* 16 帧数 Tt（padded/ HOP_LENGTH） */
  uint32_t orig_t;        /* 20 原始采样数（解码输出长度） */
  uint32_t seq;           /* 24 本片序号 */
  uint32_t ttl;           /* 28 分片总数 */
  uint32_t payload;       /* 32 本片载荷字节 */
  uint32_t crc;           /* 36 本片载荷 CRC32 */
  uint32_t chunk;         /* 40 分块序号（0..N-1），整段单发时为 0 */
  uint32_t last;          /* 44 1 = 本段最后一块 */
} jx_net_hdr_t;

/* 极讯 index 的位打包（MSB-first，与 PC 侧一致；返回位数） */
int jx_net_pack_bits(const int64_t *idx, int ntok, int bits,
                     uint8_t *out, int out_cap);
int jx_net_unpack_bits(const uint8_t *in, int nbits, int bits,
                       int64_t *idx, int max_tok);

/* 编码端：idx -> UDP 发到 ip:port。成功返回 0，负 errno。 */
int jx_net_send_idx(const char *ip, int port, int rate_id, int bits,
                    const int64_t *idx, int ntok, int tt, int orig_t,
                    uint32_t chunk, uint32_t last);

/* 解码端：UDP 收 -> idx[]（调用方 free）。timeout_s 为最长等待秒数。
 * 成功返回 0，负 errno（-ETIMEDOUT 表示没收到完整包）。 */
int jx_net_recv_idx(int port, int timeout_s, int *rate_id, int *bits,
                    int64_t **out_idx, int *out_ntok, int *out_tt,
                    int *out_orig_t, uint32_t *out_chunk, uint32_t *out_last);

#endif /* __APPS_JIXUN_CODEC_PORT_JX_NET_H */

description: Diagnosis loop for hard bugs and performance regressions. Use when the user says "diagnose"/"debug this", or reports something broken/throwing/failing/slow.

# Diagnosing Bugs

A discipline for hard bugs. Skip phases only when explicitly justified.

When exploring the codebase, read `CONTEXT.md` (if it exists) to get a clear mental model of the relevant modules, and check ADRs in the area you're touching.

## Redact

This skill has you show commands, outputs and captured artifacts. **Redact every secret first**: write `<REDACTED>` in its place. Build loops against env vars, so the credential stays in the environment rather than in what you show. Captured artifacts carry auth headers: quote only the lines that carry the signal.

If the redacted output is not enough to diagnose the bug, say so and ask the user.

## Phase 1: Build a feedback loop

**This is the skill.** Everything else is mechanical. If you have a **tight** pass/fail signal for the bug (one that goes red on _this_ bug), you will find the cause; bisection, hypothesis-testing, and instrumentation all just consume it. If you don't have one, no amount of staring at code will save you.

Spend disproportionate effort here. **Be aggressive. Be creative. Refuse to give up.**

### Ways to construct one, in roughly this order

1. **Failing test** at whatever seam reaches the bug: unit, integration, e2e.
2. **Curl / HTTP script** against a running dev server.
3. **CLI invocation** with a fixture input, diffing stdout against a known-good snapshot.
4. **Headless browser script** (Playwright / Puppeteer) that drives the UI and asserts on DOM/console/network.
5. **Replay a captured trace.** Save a real network request / payload / event log to disk; replay it through the code path in isolation.
6. **Throwaway harness.** Spin up a minimal subset of the system (one service, mocked deps) that exercises the bug code path with a single function call.
7. **Property / fuzz loop.** If the bug is "sometimes wrong output", run 1000 random inputs and look for the failure mode.
8. **Bisection harness.** If the bug appeared between two known states (commit, dataset, version), automate "boot at state X, check, repeat" so you can `git bisect run` it.
9. **Differential loop.** Run the same input through old-version vs new-version (or two configs) and diff outputs.
10. **HITL bash script.** Last resort. If a human must click, drive _them_ with `scripts/hitl-loop.template.sh` so the loop is still structured. Captured output feeds back to you.

Build the right feedback loop, and the bug is 90% fixed.

### Tighten the loop

Treat the loop as a product. Once you have _a_ loop, **tighten** it:

- Can I make it faster? (Cache setup, skip unrelated init, narrow the test scope.)
- Can I make the signal sharper? (Assert on the specific symptom, not "didn't crash".)
- Can I make it more deterministic? (Pin time, seed RNG, isolate filesystem, freeze network.)

A 30-second flaky loop is barely better than no loop; a 2-second deterministic one is tight, a debugging superpower.

### Non-deterministic bugs

The goal is not a clean repro but a **higher reproduction rate**. Loop the trigger 100×, parallelise, add stress, narrow timing windows, inject sleeps. A 50%-flake bug is debuggable; 1% is not, so keep raising the rate until it's debuggable.

### When you genuinely cannot build a loop

Stop and say so explicitly. List what you tried. Ask the user for: (a) access to whatever environment reproduces it, (b) a redacted captured artifact (HAR file, log dump, core dump, screen recording with timestamps), or (c) permission to add temporary production instrumentation. Do **not** proceed to hypothesise without a loop.

### Completion criterion: a tight loop that goes red

Phase 1 is done when the loop is **tight** and **red-capable**: you can name **one command** (a script path, a test invocation, a curl) that you have **already run at least once** (show the invocation and its output, redacted), and that is:

- [ ] **Red-capable**: it drives the actual bug code path and asserts the **user's exact symptom**, so it can go red on this bug and green once fixed. Not "runs without erroring"; it must be able to _catch this specific bug_.
- [ ] **Deterministic**: same verdict every run (flaky bugs: a pinned, high reproduction rate, per above).
- [ ] **Fast**: seconds, not minutes.
- [ ] **Agent-runnable**: you can run it unattended; a human in the loop only via `scripts/hitl-loop.template.sh`.

If you catch yourself reading code to build a theory before this command exists, **stop: jumping straight to a hypothesis is the exact failure this skill prevents.** No red-capable command, no Phase 2.

## Phase 2: Reproduce + minimise

Run the loop. Watch it go red as the bug appears.

Confirm:

- [ ] The loop produces the failure mode the **user** described, not a different failure that happens to be nearby. Wrong bug = wrong fix.
- [ ] The failure is reproducible across multiple runs (or, for non-deterministic bugs, reproducible at a high enough rate to debug against).
- [ ] You have captured the exact symptom (error message, wrong output, slow timing) so later phases can verify the fix actually addresses it.

### Minimise

Once it's red, shrink the repro to the **smallest scenario that still goes red**. Cut inputs, callers, config, data, and steps **one at a time**, re-running the loop after each cut, and keep only what's load-bearing for the failure.

Why bother: a minimal repro shrinks the hypothesis space in Phase 3 (fewer moving parts left to suspect) and becomes the clean regression test in Phase 5.

Done when **every remaining element is load-bearing**: removing any one of them makes the loop go green.

Do not proceed until you have reproduced **and** minimised.

## Phase 3: Hypothesise

Generate **3–5 ranked hypotheses** before testing any of them. Single-hypothesis generation anchors on the first plausible idea.

Each hypothesis must be **falsifiable**: state the prediction it makes.

> Format: "If <X> is the cause, then <changing Y> will make the bug disappear / <changing Z> will make it worse."

If you cannot state the prediction, the hypothesis is a vibe: discard or sharpen it.

**Show the ranked list to the user before testing.** They often have domain knowledge that re-ranks instantly ("we just deployed a change to #3"), or know hypotheses they've already ruled out. Cheap checkpoint, big time saver. Don't block on it; proceed with your ranking if the user is AFK.

## Phase 4: Instrument

Each probe must map to a specific prediction from Phase 3. **Change one variable at a time.**

Tool preference:

1. **Debugger / REPL inspection** if the env supports it. One breakpoint beats ten logs.
2. **Targeted logs** at the boundaries that distinguish hypotheses.
3. Never "log everything and grep".

**Tag every debug log** with a unique prefix, e.g. `[DEBUG-a4f2]`. Cleanup at the end becomes a single grep. Untagged logs survive; tagged logs die.

**Perf branch.** For performance regressions, logs are usually wrong. Instead: establish a baseline measurement (timing harness, `performance.now()`, profiler, query plan), then bisect. Measure first, fix second.

## Phase 5: Fix + regression test

Write the regression test **before the fix**, but only if there is a **correct seam** for it.

A correct seam is one where the test exercises the **real bug pattern** as it occurs at the call site. If the only available seam is too shallow (single-caller test when the bug needs multiple callers, unit test that can't replicate the chain that triggered the bug), a regression test there gives false confidence.

**If no correct seam exists, that itself is the finding.** Note it. The codebase architecture is preventing the bug from being locked down. Flag this for the next phase.

If a correct seam exists:

1. Turn the minimised repro into a failing test at that seam.
2. Watch it fail.
3. Apply the fix.
4. Watch it pass.
5. Re-run the Phase 1 feedback loop against the original (un-minimised) scenario.

## Phase 6: Cleanup

Required before declaring done:

- [ ] Original repro no longer reproduces (re-run the Phase 1 loop)
- [ ] Regression test passes (or absence of seam is documented)
- [ ] All `[DEBUG-...]` instrumentation removed (`grep` the prefix)
- [ ] Throwaway prototypes deleted (or moved to a clearly-marked debug location)
- [ ] The hypothesis that turned out correct is stated in the commit / PR message, so the next debugger learns

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""中文闭环：监听板端“录音中”提示，同步播放 PC 中文测试音，并接收板端 UDP 解码。"""

import argparse

import _pc_udp_voice as pcv


class Board:
    def __init__(self, port):
        self.port = port
        self.p = serial.Serial(port=None, baudrate=115200, timeout=0.05)
        self.p._dtr_state = False
        self.p._rts_state = False
        self.p.port = port
        self.p.open()

    def send(self, text, wait):
        self.p.write(text.encode() + b"\r")
        return self.pump(wait)

    def pump(self, seconds):
        out = ""
        end = time.time() + seconds
        while time.time() < end:
            data = self.p.read(4096)
            if data:
                text = data.decode("utf-8", "replace")
                sys.stdout.write(text)
                sys.stdout.flush()
                out += text
        return out

    def close(self):
        self.p.close()

    def __init__(self, port, no_play=False):
        super().__init__(daemon=True)
        self.port = port
        self.no_play = no_play
        self.ready = threading.Event()
        self.done = threading.Event()
        self.result = None

    def run(self):
        rx = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
        rx.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_RCVBUF, 256 * 1024)
        rx.bind(("0.0.0.0", self.port))
        rx.settimeout(1.0)
        self.ready.set()
        parts = {}
        deadline = time.time() + 90

        while time.time() < deadline:
            try:
                pkt, addr = rx.recvfrom(2048)
            except socket.timeout:
                continue
            if len(pkt) < pcv.HDR.size:
                continue

            fields = pcv.HDR.unpack_from(pkt)
            (magic, ver, rate_id, bits, reserved, ntok, tt, orig_t,
             seq, ttl, payload_len, crc, chunk, last) = fields
            if magic != pcv.MAGIC or ver != 2:
                continue

            payload = pkt[pcv.HDR.size:pcv.HDR.size + payload_len]
            if len(payload) != payload_len or pcv.crc32(payload) != crc:
                continue

            parts[(chunk, seq)] = payload
            if sum(1 for (c, _) in parts if c == chunk) < ttl:
                continue

            blob = b"".join(parts[(chunk, i)] for i in range(ttl))
            idx = pcv.unpack_bits(blob, ntok, bits)
            stamp = time.strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
            idx_path = pcv.OUT_DIR / f"cn_voice_{stamp}.idx"
            wav_path = pcv.OUT_DIR / f"cn_voice_{stamp}.wav"
            with idx_path.open("wb") as f:
                f.write(struct.pack("<iii", 1, tt, orig_t))
                for v in idx:
                    f.write(struct.pack("<q", v))

            codec = pcv.CODEC_DIR / pcv.CODEC.get(rate_id, pcv.CODEC[1])
            print(f"\n[pc] UDP complete: idx={idx_path}")

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""PC 侧语音闭环接收器：UDP JXC1 -> idx -> 本机 codec decode -> PC 音箱。"""

import argparse
import os
import socket
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import threading
import time
import wave
import zlib
from pathlib import Path

MAGIC = 0x3143584A
HDR = struct.Struct("<IHHHHIIIIIIIII")

}


def crc32(data):
    return zlib.crc32(data) & 0xFFFFFFFF


def unpack_bits(payload, ntok, bits):
    out = []
    bitpos = 0
    for _ in range(ntok):
        v = 0
        for _ in range(bits):
            v = (v << 1) | ((payload[bitpos >> 3] >> (7 - (bitpos & 7))) & 1)
            bitpos += 1
        out.append(v)
    return out


def play_async(path):
    try:

        winsound.PlaySound(str(path), winsound.SND_FILENAME | winsound.SND_ASYNC)
        return True
    except Exception as exc:
        print(f"[pc] playback failed: {exc}")
        return False


def inject_wav(path, delay):
    time.sleep(max(0.0, delay))
    print(f"[pc] inject speaker: {path}")
    play_async(path)


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=45678)
    ap.add_argument("--timeout", type=int, default=120)
    ap.add_argument("--inject-wav", default="")
    ap.add_argument("--inject-delay", type=float, default=0.0)
    ap.add_argument("--no-play", action="store_true")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    OUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    rx = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
    rx.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_RCVBUF, 256 * 1024)
    rx.bind(("0.0.0.0", args.port))
    rx.settimeout(1.0)
    print(f"[pc] listening UDP 0.0.0.0:{args.port}")

    if args.inject_wav:
        threading.Thread(
            target=inject_wav,
            args=(args.inject_wav, args.inject_delay),
            daemon=True,
        ).start()

    deadline = time.time() + args.timeout
    parts = {}
    meta = None
    first_seen = None

    while time.time() < deadline:
        try:
            pkt, addr = rx.recvfrom(2048)
        except socket.timeout:

        if len(pkt) < HDR.size:
            continue

        fields = HDR.unpack_from(pkt)

        if magic != MAGIC or ver != 2:
            continue

        payload = pkt[HDR.size:HDR.size + payload_len]
        if len(payload) != payload_len or crc32(payload) != crc:
            print(f"[pc] bad packet chunk={chunk} seq={seq}")
            continue

        if meta is None:

            print(

                f"Tt={tt} orig={orig_t} chunks={ttl}"
            )

        key = (chunk, seq)
        if key not in parts:
            parts[key] = payload
            print(f"[pc] chunk={chunk} seq={seq}/{ttl - 1} from {addr[0]}:{addr[1]}")

        if sum(1 for (c, _), _ in parts.items() if c == chunk) >= ttl:
            blob = b"".join(parts[(chunk, i)] for i in range(ttl))
            idx = unpack_bits(blob, ntok, bits)

            stamp = time.strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
            idx_path = OUT_DIR / f"voice_{stamp}.idx"
            wav_path = OUT_DIR / f"voice_{stamp}.wav"
            with idx_path.open("wb") as f:
                f.write(struct.pack("<iii", 1, tt, orig_t))
                for v in idx:
                    f.write(struct.pack("<q", v))

            codec_name = CODEC.get(rate_id, CODEC[1])
            codec_path = CODEC_DIR / codec_name
            print(f"[pc] decoded idx saved: {idx_path}")
            print(f"[pc] codec: {codec_path}")

            if codec_path.exists():
                rc = subprocess.run(
                    [str(codec_path), "recv", str(idx_path), str(wav_path)],

                if rc == 0 and wav_path.exists():

                    if not args.no_play:

            else:
                print("[pc] codec executable missing")

            return 0

    print("[pc] timeout waiting for complete voice frame")

```
[24] a 4B 顺序写       :    4.88 周期/元素   196.8 MB/s     <-- 顺序写很快
[24] b 16B vst.128 写  :   19.71 周期/元素    48.7 MB/s     <-- 128 位向量写反而慢 4 倍

[26] a 单核 读4MB      :   394.3 ms    85.1 MB/s

[26] d 单核 32KB常驻   :    57.5 ms   291.8 MB/s   <-- L1 常驻
[26] e 双核 各2x32KB   :    90.1 ms   372.6 MB/s   <-- 只有 1.28 倍！
```

**读 85 MB/s、写 197 MB/s —— 读是第一硬约束。** 而 L1 常驻只有 292 MB/s
（约 0.30 float/周期，约 3.3 周期/次读），比 PSRAM 只快 3.4 倍。

### 2.2 最关键的发现：双核并行只有 1.37x（最大单块收益 1100 ms）

```
JX_PF=1（双核）: encode 1550 / decode 2050 / total 3600
JX_PF=0（单核）: encode 2100 / decode 2830 / total 4930
```

- 单核把两份工作都做完要 **4930 ms**，双核只到 3600 ms => **加速比 1.37x，不是 2x**。
- `[pf]` 双核下 CPU0 3145.9 + serial-fallback 334.1 + CPU1 2988.2 = **6468 ms**，
  而单核跑同一份工作只要 **4930 ms** => **总工作量凭空膨胀 24%**。
  这 24% 就是两核互相踩资源的直接代价。**修好并行效率的理论下限 = 4930 / 2 = 2465 ms。**

## 三、下一步方向（按「预期收益 / 风险」排序）

### P0-a　并行分解改成「共享输入、切输出」（预期 3590 -> 约 2900 ms）
- 依据：`[26]c` 证明两核读**同一份**数据时带宽接近 2x，读**不同**数据时几乎不涨。
- 现状：`jx_pf_run_min` 一律按行/按时间块切成互不相交的两半，两核读的是不同数据，
  于是既拿不到带宽翻倍，还互相踩 L1，把总工作量抬高 24%。
- 做法（逐内核评估）：对「输入读远大于权重读、且量化不在并行区内」的内核
  （首选 `jx_linear_i8_rows`，in=352 的层），把分解从「按行切」改成
  「两核跑同一批输入行、切输出通道块」，让两条读流落在同一批 L1 行上。
- 风险：若内核里「输入量化」是按输入行做的（如 k1cf 的 A_max+B_quant 占 40%），
  切输出会让两核**重复量化**，必须先看能不能把量化结果共享。

### P0-b　降低每元素指令条数（寄存器分块 / 循环交换）
- 目标：把最热循环的每元素访存从 **7~8 次降到 3 次以内**。
- 手法（以 l1 epilogue 为例，`csrc/int8_kernels.c` 约 2434~2620 行）：
  参数数组 `g_sna / g_sni / g_gg / g_gb + swc / sbb` 都按**通道 i** 索引、与行 r 无关；
  现在 `for r { for i { 读 6 个参数 } }`，改成**一次处理 2~4 行**：
  `for i { 读一次参数; 用于 r、r+1、r+2、r+3 }`。
  `ssr_acc` 拆成 2~4 个独立累加器（行间独立、行内按 i 递增 => **逐位一致**）。
  需要多份 `accb`（已有 `accb`/`accb2`，再加 1~2 份，每份 cn x int32）。
- 预期：l1 epilogue 139.1 Mcyc（580 core-ms）可望降到约 90 Mcyc，省约 120 ms 墙钟；
  同样手法可套到 k1cf epilogue（82.7 Mcyc）与各逐元素算子（`ew/fbr/cnorm/dwtc/snake/ups/glue`
  合计约 2000 core-ms）。

### P1　int8 激活端到端（B 方案）
- 依据：P0 探针 `[q6] 纯写 float 行 18.7 / [q7] 纯写 int8 行 2.3`、
  `[q8] 读 float 9.4 / 读 int8 4.7`。producer 写出的行是**跨 T_out 步进的散点写**
  （约 18.7 周期/元素），int8 化后既少 4 倍字节又变成一次 16 字节写。
- 预期：所有 float 输出（约 1000 万元素）省约 16 周期/元素 => **约 350 ms 墙钟**，
  再叠加消费者读侧约 100 ms；合计 **约 450 ms**（3590 -> 约 3150 ms）。
- 注意：本轮新证据表明逐元素算子更多是**指令受限**而非字节受限，所以 int8 的红利
  主要来自「producer 的散点行写」和「消费者少读 3/4 字节」，不要期望 4x。
- 需要所有消费者接受 int8 + per-row scale，并逐层过 SNR 门禁
  （per-position 动态量化精度会下降）。

### 已确认无效 / 不要再做
- 环境开关：`JX_EPG(0..5)` / `JX_PFMIN` / `JX_DCP*` / `JX_K1JB` / `JX_K1TB` / `JX_K1WC` /

name: diagnosing-bugs
description: Diagnosis loop for hard bugs and performance regressions. Use when the user says "diagnose"/"debug this", or reports something broken/throwing/failing/slow.
